description: Company open roles. Use when a task needs the roles one named company is hiring for right now: the live list from that company's own Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby job board, with title, location, department, team, employment type, remote flag, posted date and a link to apply, and optionally the description as plain text. Give a board token or the careers-page URL; the provider is detected either way. Cost: 2 credits per call.

careers_url.description: The company's Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby careers page. The provider and board token are derived from it.

company.description: The company's board token, as it appears in its job-board URL. Required unless careers_url is sent.

include_description.description: Include each role's description as plain text. Off by default, because it makes the response much larger.

provider.description: auto (default), greenhouse, lever or ashby. Refused if it disagrees with careers_url.

name: company_jobs
